objective: Make HTTP the only owner of AI, OCR, LLM, and import-learning transport responses while preserving every live REST contract and deleting unreachable core transport surfaces.

architecture.owner: crate-private import_routes/ai_response_contract.rs using the existing ImportV2RouteResponse and route_response
retained_core_capabilities: provider catalog, authentication, allowlist, and secret redaction
payment screenshot parsing and receipt draft projection
prompt construction and provider-independent typed observations
deleted_boundaries: isomorphic core AiRouteResponse carrier and duplicate ai_route_response adapter
core AI, OCR, and LLM REST status and envelope builders
response-to-response field copying and response-body reverse extraction
the entire zero-production-caller core import-learning route-response surface
unchanged_boundaries: REST paths, status codes, success and error envelope fields
OCR errorCode and message values plus LLM code and error_code compatibility
OCR yuan input boundary, receipt draft, provenance, confidence, and raw provider response
provider SSRF, rate-limit, authentication, persistence, and invocation ordering
database schema, user scope, configuration storage, transaction, and writer contracts
rejected_expansion: response-builder trait, service, port, UnitOfWork, registry, cache, or new crate
a second transport carrier or compatibility re-export
moving OCR parsing or receipt-draft policy into HTTP

red.result: failed because core still owned AiRouteResponse and the AI/OCR REST builders

green.command: focused HTTP AI/OCR/LLM response projection tests

review.standards_axis: APPROVE with P0=0, P1=0, and P2=0

verification.money_review: OCR extraction and receipt draft amount remain at the existing yuan external boundary; no cents storage or API amount field changed.
verification.delivery_evidence: Gitea PR, exact-head Actions, squash merge, and branch-deletion evidence are added after delivery.

false_starts: The first broad HTTP library test ran without BILL_ANALYSER_TEST_POSTGRES_URL; its only failure was the explicit fail-closed PostgreSQL environment contract. The authoritative runs used fresh isolated databases.

The first changed-line calculation used an unstaged diff and omitted the new untracked owner file; it was rejected and rerun from the staged exact-base diff, producing 172 of 172 covered executable lines.
residual_risks: ImportV2RouteResponse remains a narrow historical name for the now shared private import, AI, OCR, and LLM transport carrier; renaming it would be broad mechanical churn and is intentionally deferred.
This ownership cutover does not complete import performance, signal lifecycle, LLM business policy, or CI topology work.
No live or paid provider was invoked; provider behavior remains covered by deterministic local and loopback fixtures.

environment_hygiene.provider_strategy: no live or paid OCR or LLM endpoint was called
